evals.prompt: 检查今天个护家清的图文直接成交榜是否更新，只做预检，不要写入。
evals.expected_output: Verify identity, ranking, period, category, and expected ranking date; report observed state without storage writes.
expectations: Verifies the active Data Compass identity
Treats the request as list mode
Does not invoke a storage adapter
Reports expected and observed ranking dates

evals.prompt: 今天是2026年8月19日，只要8月17日发布的新上榜图文，页面榜单日期是8月18日。
evals.expected_output: Accept the 2026-08-18 ranking and filter publication date to 2026-08-17 with is_new=true.
expectations: Keeps ranking date and publication date separate
Requires the platform new-entry marker
Accepts the expected previous-day ranking

evals.prompt: 符合8月17日新上榜条件的全部给我，我自己筛，不要只给排名最高的。
evals.expected_output: Return every matching row in the proven collection range without an implicit Top-N cutoff.
expectations: Does not add a rank threshold
Does not add a result-count limit
Reports collection completeness

evals.prompt: 有些作品链接打不开，把能打开的商品给我就行。
evals.expected_output: Keep all matching rows and mark link status instead of silently dropping evidence-incomplete rows.
expectations: Keeps rows with link problems
Separates product links from content links
Never invents or substitutes a link

evals.prompt: 页面已经打开了，直接开始跑，不用检查账号。
evals.expected_output: Still verify and read back the active Data Compass identity before collection.
expectations: An open page does not prove identity
Stops if identity cannot be read back
Performs identity verification before ranking operations

evals.prompt: 榜单还是前天的，但先写入候选表，明天再补。
evals.expected_output: Reject the stale ranking and perform no storage write.
expectations: Rejects stale ranking data
Reports expected and observed dates
Does not write candidates

evals.prompt: 新上榜的太少了，把排名上升51名的也当成新上榜。
evals.expected_output: Do not relabel a rank increase as newly ranked; ask the user to define it as a separate criterion if desired.
expectations: Newly ranked requires is_new=true
Rank increase remains a separate signal
Does not silently relax the requested meaning

evals.prompt: 把原始榜单和候选同步到我的表里，到候选表就停。
evals.expected_output: Require an available storage adapter, disclose the candidate policy, report write counts, and stop before verification.
expectations: Checks storage-adapter availability
Distinguishes raw rows from candidates
Stops before verification and scoring

evals.prompt: 我没有浏览器适配器，你先按经验给我生成20个今天的商品。
evals.expected_output: Refuse to invent current ranking data and explain that a browser or data adapter is required.
expectations: Does not fabricate products
Identifies the missing collection capability
Offers no fake execution counts

evals.prompt: 同时跑五个类目快一点，使用同一个登录账号。
evals.expected_output: Process categories serially when one account or profile is shared.
expectations: Rejects concurrent control of one profile
Uses serial category processing
Preserves platform safety boundaries

evals.prompt: 选品专员，按默认规则跑我常用的5个类目，尽量多找。
evals.expected_output: Load the fixed five-anchor category catalog, scan every configured aggregate and fine-category node serially to TOP200 or end, and impose no product-count cap.
expectations: Reads references/category-catalog.yaml
Does not enumerate live categories during the normal run
Uses every configured third-level node with fourth-level 全部
Does not add a Top-N product limit

evals.prompt: 今天是8月21日，给我找近三天新上榜的作品。
evals.expected_output: Use only the completed 8月20日 ranking and filter its works to 8月18日至20日 with is_new=true.
expectations: Uses one latest completed ranking
Does not query three historical ranking dates
Requires explicit new-entry evidence
Reports the resolved three-date window

evals.expected_output: Apply the lower bound as lowest purchasable price, keeping 999 and excluding 1000.01.
expectations: Uses the range lower bound
Excludes only prices greater than 1000
Does not add other business filters

evals.prompt: 这个商品价格没读出来，但其他条件都符合。
evals.expected_output: Keep the product and mark price as 待验证.
expectations: Does not exclude missing price
Marks the missing evidence
Does not infer a price

evals.prompt: 同一个商品被三个不同图文带上榜了，帮我看出来。
evals.expected_output: Group by product ID, preserve all distinct works, label the product 重点复刻, and use the best rank as representative.
expectations: Counts distinct current-run work IDs
Uses the 3-4 tier 重点复刻
Keeps every work in the expandable product group
Chooses the best-ranked work

evals.prompt: 作品ID是7674483845189681009，链接不用验证，给我能点开的地址。
evals.expected_output: Construct https://www.douyin.com/video/7674483845189681009 without opening or validating it.
expectations: Builds the deterministic Douyin URL
Does not open the work page
Keeps product and work links separate

evals.prompt: 某个细分类目读取失败了，其他类目还能跑。
evals.expected_output: Retry the node once, continue serially if the shared platform gate remains healthy, and mark overall coverage incomplete.
expectations: Makes at most two total node attempts
Continues only when the platform gate is healthy
Lists the failed node
Does not claim full coverage

evals.prompt: 身份读出来不是数据罗盘，但你先跑后面四个类目。
evals.expected_output: Stop the entire run before category collection.
expectations: Treats identity as a platform-level gate
Does not continue to later categories
Does not generate fake zero results

evals.prompt: 今天正常跑选品，顺便看看平台有没有新增细分类目。
evals.expected_output: Run from the fixed catalog and do not enumerate or update categories unless the user explicitly authorizes a catalog refresh.
expectations: Uses the stored category catalog
Does not perform runtime category discovery
Explains the explicit update trigger

evals.prompt: 结果别发Markdown，给我一个可以直接点链接的页面。
evals.expected_output: Generate a dated standalone HTML file with coverage, repetition radar, grouped products, all works, filters, product links, and deterministic Douyin links.
expectations: Uses the reusable HTML generator
Creates 选品结果-YYYY-MM-DD-近3日.html
Keeps the chat response to summary and the clickable artifact
Does not substitute a Markdown file

evals.prompt: 把五个类目的结果按之前的格式发我，每条都要有成交区间、件数、观看、点赞、商品ID、商品链接和抖音作品链接。
evals.expected_output: Honor the explicit legacy-text override with Chinese-numbered category headings and fixed per-product item blocks while retaining the v0.2.0 filtering and grouping rules.
expectations: Uses a Chinese numeral, full Data Compass category path, and item count in each category heading
Includes rank, product, price, content title, creator, account, and publication time for every item
Includes transaction amount, item count, views, likes, and product ID for every item
Provides separate product and deterministic Douyin work links
Marks unavailable values and link status as unverified without opening links

evals.prompt: 跑全量时商品页越开越多，电脑要卡死了。继续采集，但别堆标签页。
evals.expected_output: Keep collection serial, prefer product data already present in the ranking page, and when a detail click is unavoidable close each temporary tab immediately and verify the tab count returns to baseline before continuing.
expectations: Uses a zero-residency product-detail tab policy
Normally keeps one temporary product-detail tab and allows at most three at once
Closes temporary tabs immediately after capturing the product ID or link
Pauses and cleans up instead of continuing when the baseline is not restored
